name_ja: エスキモーコシャクシギ

neutral.anchor_measurement: Assistant visual registration on native raster; approximate anatomical feet projection, not alpha-box centering or subpixel metrology.
neutral.anchor_basis: Rounded head/trunk through two short leg/foot supports; excludes projecting curved bill and small rear tail from body width. Anchor is the projected midpoint between the two visible foot soles. Toy-like leg proportions are intentional prop simplification.
neutral.vertical_motion_policy: Consumer places this recorded anchor explicitly and designs any motion; no locomotion or ground shift is inferred from this neutral.

geometry_policy: Native pixels and adopted per-frame references retained. Atlas neutral coordinates are shifted only by the adopted crop origin.

taxonomy.verification_scope: Primary linked sources check the identity/selected diagnostic traits where listed; visual_traits are a concise original artistic brief, not a claim of exhaustive field-identification accuracy.
